FILE-08.note: Pref 'Backup before save' (on by default): before the save, the mod's own copy of each changed file goes to <mod>/.arsenal-bak/<rel>.bak (outside resource, so the game never loads it). Only saves made from the Files tab or Ctrl+S back up; the core bar's Save button does not (see report).
